notes: 0.6.1：一批稳定性修复。包安装的备份逻辑不再可能在目录被占用时丢文件；托盘菜单快照损坏不再冻结界面；「编译为 EXE」失败时旧产物不再消失；脚本下载窗的包模式脚本装完后正确显示「已下载」；多实例的 MCP 校验/预览不再互相串台；提权重启更稳。脚本列表换新视觉：列头浅灰是唯一的灰色横带，分组头白底、组名加粗，组界线挂在每个分组头上方，列头与首个分组之间的间隙取消；顺带根治了选项里「管理员权限」勾选框悬停时文字重影。
notes_en: 0.6.1: A batch of stability fixes. Package-install backup no longer risks losing files when a directory is locked; a damaged tray-menu snapshot no longer freezes the UI; a failed 'compile to EXE' no longer leaves the destination empty; the script downloader now shows 'installed' for package-mode scripts right after install; concurrent MCP instances no longer cross-validate or cross-run each other's editor content; the elevated relaunch is race-free. The script list gets a new look: the column header is the only grey band, group headers are white with bold names, a group boundary line sits above each group header, and the old gap under the header is gone. Also fixes the ghosting text on the 'Administrator' checkbox hover in Options.
